BOOP! GOTCHA!

Backrooms: Wander

You start in the original yellow Backrooms. Keep wandering: the halls change as you advance, all the way to a retro apartment at the far end.

VR: left menu button (or left stick click) opens the map; on desktop press M. Left stick walks, hold A to run, B jumps, right stick turns. You can still push off walls, floor and ceiling with your hands to launch yourself. Press Y if you feel too high or low. Furniture is noclip. Look for the ladder, kitchen, couch, stairs, stop sign, arch, wooden door, graffiti wall and balcony railing; wall windows show mountain views. Walk far enough and the halls turn into an empty mall, then a dark graffiti lobby, then the apartment. One room in the apartment has black pitfall holes that drop you somewhere random.
